neutral_target_evidence: Authors define Parent × female applicant as the motherhood penalty interaction, and Workplace evaluations explicitly links negative Table4 interactions to mothers being less suitable for hiring. Hire? column is a binary-logit estimate. Shipped .570 is the main Parent effect for the male-applicant baseline, not that interaction.
analytic_N: Table4 explicitly reports188 participants with robust SE clustered by participant ID; paired applicant ratings do not double participant N.
formatting_rule: Field-scoped OCR-minus normalization requires current target-confirmed review, exact value/metric/source label, literal coefficient quote and explicit negative context. Global numeric parser remains unchanged. No arithmetic, standardization, or sign reversal of the effect.
p_bound: Do not count p<.1 versus reportedp<.001 as a precision error under the established nested-bound compatibility rule.
